notes.title: BARKOUR – Play the Japanese Demo at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.notes: [p]BARKOUR is coming to [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b]! Players will have the chance to play the [b]Japanese-language demo[/b], carefully localized for the event.[/p][p]Keep your eyes peeled… a [b]special BARKOUR reveal is just around the corner[/b] for our Steam community, giving fans a sneak peek at what’s next![/p][p]Experience T.H.U.N.D.E.R., the secret agent dog, in action and explore new gadgets, parkour challenges, and exciting fights. This is the perfect opportunity for fans and press to see the game in a fully localized environment before upcoming future announcements.[/p]

notes.title: BARKOUR - Sneak, Bark & Backflip at PAX West 2025! 🐾
notes.notes: [p][b]BARKOUR is Coming to PAX West 2025![/b] 🎮🐾[/p][p]Seattle, get ready! We’re bringing [b]BARKOUR[/b] to [b]PAX West 2025[/b] from [b]Friday, August 29 to Monday, September 1[/b], and can’t wait to show you our newest demo – even fresher than the one at Gamescom![/p][p]Find us at [b]Booth #1125, Games From Poland[/b], right next to the [b]PAX Rising Showcase[/b], and be among the first in the USA to sneak, bark, and backflip with T.H.U.N.D.E.R., our heroic secret agent dog. 🐕💨[/p][p]Come play, meet the devs, and share your thoughts – we’ve tuned the gameplay even more since Gamescom to make it chaotic, fast, and fur-tastically fun![/p][p]See you in Seattle! 🌟[/p]

notes.title: BARKOUR Demo Coming to Gamescom - Get Ready for Stealthy, Action-Packed Fun!
notes.notes: [p][b]BARKOUR – We're Ready to Share![/b][/p][p]It’s been a long journey, but we’re finally here – ready to share [b]BARKOUR[/b] with you all! 🚀 We’ve taken our time, carefully balancing the gameplay and crafting a truly unique experience, and now we’re excited to start the conversation with you about the game, not just the "dog agent game." [b]Gamescom[/b] has always been a huge milestone for us in every project, and [b]BARKOUR[/b] is no exception. But we also know from experience that rushing a game before it's ready only leads to compromises in quality. We wanted to make sure [b]T.H.U.N.D.E.R.[/b] (our dog agent protagonist) and his story were just right before we introduced him to the world.[/p][p]One of the reasons we’ve waited this long to start our public communication is that we chose a particularly challenging protagonist – a dog, no less! 🐾 A stealth-agent dog, to be exact. Developing a character like [b]T.H.U.N.D.E.R.[/b] took us through numerous iterations and adjustments to get the gameplay balance just right. We wanted a dog who could sneak, bark, and backflip with style, but we also needed to make sure he appealed to all types of players, whether they love action or stealth. The work paid off, and we’re proud of the result – but it took time, care, and a lot of fine-tuning. 🎮💥[/p][p]In addition to refining the gameplay, we've also fine-tuned the game description on our Steam page to reflect the final product, and we’ve added an entirely new [b]key art[/b] that finally showcases the full dynamics of [b]BARKOUR[/b]! 🔥[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that for the first time, we’ll be presenting a playable demo of [b]BARKOUR[/b] at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]. This is your first chance to get hands-on with [b]T.H.U.N.D.E.R.’s[/b] daring escapades in a chaotic world full of villains and gadgets. While we can't give you an exact date just yet, we plan to release the demo on Steam after the event, depending on the feedback we gather during the exhibition. This will help us make the game and the first Steam demo the best it can be before a wider release. 🕶️💣[/p][p]So, get ready to sneak, bark, and backflip your way through villainous encounters with [b]BARKOUR[/b] – we can’t wait to hear what you think! Stay tuned for more updates as we move closer to the demo release, and don’t forget to follow us on Steam to stay in the loop! 🎉[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]More details on where to find us during Gamescom:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.gamescom.global/en/exhibitor/varsav"]Gamescom Product Page - BARKOUR[/url][/p]
